person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies William L Collins, no rank, a literal six-digit value and Box 136. The value was not padded or forced into an eight-digit Army identifier. person_updates.next_action: Review Box 136 to confirm or reject the Yolande de Mauduit Collins candidate and establish personnel status, pre-OSS occupation or employer, and OSS assignment.
